verifiedSemantics: The explicit all-to-all dispatcher separates dispatch, tensor-parallel gathering, expert computation, tensor-parallel reduction/scattering and inverse combine.
The flex dispatcher can use a group spanning both tensor- and expert-parallel ranks.
authoredAssumptions: Forward-only synthetic E=4, top-k=2 gated MoE subgraph, with EP=2 and TP=1 or 2; all experts remain resident.
Every global token routes to one expert in each owner. The balanced profile touches both experts per owner; the concentrated profile touches one, with the same number of token assignments.
Route packets carry BF16 activations, int64 expert indices and FP32 probabilities: 2H+12 bytes per assignment. Token order is known from the declared fixed routing map.
One TP×EP dispatch and two separate owner combine collectives are declared; these are not a claim to reproduce a fused production dispatcher.

Owner preparation/unpacking and repacking use distinct buffers with explicit HBM traffic. Transport workspace=0 is an ideal-buffer assumption; communication local HBM and reduction arithmetic remain unknown.
Artificial matrix/vector ceilings 1000 operations/s, HBM 100 byte/s, network 1000 byte/s, per-round latency 0.001 seconds, and 4096-byte devices are arithmetic references only.
